decisions.decision: Sampler and SPU-94 are separate products connected at audio level
decisions.rationale: Anthony wants them to feel like two independent codebases wired together

decisions.decision: Global sampler send replaces per-voice EON
decisions.rationale: Simpler for now; per-voice routing deferred

decisions.decision: Sampler bus independent from ADPCM coloration bus
decisions.rationale: Own fader and send so sampler volume doesn't couple to live input ADPCM level

decisions.decision: Mixer bottom row: Dry knob alone, then Input | Sampler | Reverb
decisions.rationale: Dry is clean passthrough; Input/Sampler/Reverb all touch ADPCM

decisions.decision: Toolbar order: Input Gain | Input Rate | Gauss | AA | sends
decisions.rationale: Input controls grouped left, sends grouped right
Teal clashed with waveform; coral has good contrast

decisions.decision: One-shot default, loop mode reveals loop marker
decisions.rationale: Loop is opt-in with a selector
Gauss bypass for raw zero-order-hold aliasing as creative texture

decisions.decision: Aliasing is a creative texture, not a defect
decisions.rationale: Core project philosophy: hardware artifacts ARE the sound
